name: backoff escalates 1s,2s,4s on repeated failures (jittered, capped 60s)
observed: Observed delays [1.2, 1.0, 0.9, 2.3]: every drop restarts at ~1s because `attempt` resets to 0 after any successful connect, so a flapping link (connect OK, drop after 100ms) reconnects ~once per second forever. Escalation only happens on failed connects (untestable live without blocking 993 egress -> SKIPPED live; verified by code: imap_client.backoff_delay 1,2,4..60 x0.8-1.2).
fix: Reset `attempt` only after the connection has been stable for >= 30s; otherwise flapping links hammer Gmail (risk: temporary IP/account throttling)

name: service recovers fully after rapid drops (connected, no waiters stuck)
[OFFLINE SIM + CODE-REVIEW] breaker trips after exactly 3 AUTHENTICATIONFAILED
[OFFLINE SIM] no further login attempts once open (8s observed)
[CODE-REVIEW] recovery requires manual restart (no auto-reset, no half-open probe)
observed: run() sleeps 5s forever once `_auth_tripped`; nothing clears it. A transient Gmail AUTHENTICATIONFAILED burst (rotated app password restored, Google hiccup) permanently kills OTP retrieval until `systemctl restart`, and Restart=always does not help because the process stays alive and 'healthy' to systemd.
fix: Add a half-open probe (one login attempt every 30-60 min) or a systemd watchdog / health-based restart (ExecStartPost + WatchdogSec with sd_notify), and alert on 503 auth_failed. Document the manual recovery procedure

name: [CODE-REVIEW] non-AUTHENTICATIONFAILED login errors never trip a breaker
observed: Any other login failure (e.g. '[ALERT] Application-specific password required', 'Too many simultaneous connections', LOGIN-disabled, missing/unreadable password file -> FileNotFoundError) goes down the generic `except Exception` path: retries forever with backoff capped at 60s and never marks health unhealthy (degraded=false, last_auth_failure=null).
fix: Classify [ALERT]/[AUTHENTICATIONFAILED]/'Invalid credentials' and OSError(password file) as auth-class failures that count toward the breaker; expose last_error in /health

name: [CODE-REVIEW] auth counter is 'consecutive'
observed: `_auth_failures` resets only on successful connect (`_connect` end) and increments only on AuthFailed; interleaved network errors do not reset it (conservative). Retry delay between attempts 1s/2s so the breaker trips ~3s after start: with a typo'd/rotated password a restart-loop (systemd RestartSec=5 only matters on crash) cannot hammer Gmail beyond 3 logins per process start

name: [CODE-REVIEW] half-open TCP detection window
observed: IDLE is re-issued every 25 min (IDLE_REISSUE_S). If the TCP path dies silently, `_end_idle` sends DONE into the void and `readline()` blocks until the 60s socket timeout -> reconnect. Worst-case blind window = ~26 min during which no push arrives; waiters only rescue themselves because every new wait() does an explicit SEARCH (which needs the lock and would also hang 60s) so latency spikes, and `IdleStalled` (2x window = 50 min) is effectively unreachable. Also last_successful_poll is not updated in IDLE keepalives and `connected` is just `_conn is not None`.
fix: Re-issue IDLE every 5-10 min (Gmail allows <=29), enable TCP keepalive, and use a socket timeout << 60s for DONE/readline; update last_successful_poll on each IDLE cycle
